name: mentor
description: Plan-first agent workflow: approve a plan once, then mentor runs it to a verified done-check, pausing only for always-pause actions and logging every decision for review.

interface.shortDescription: Approve once; agents run the plan to a verified done.
interface.longDescription: Plan any goal, settle questions by evidence or decision-maker agents, approve once, then run every step to an independently verified PASS with a decision log and a Done review. Software changes add a runtime playbook for tests, PRs, and merging.
defaultPrompt: Plan this and run it until it's done.
Grill this plan before I approve it.
Set up the always-pause list for this repo.
